

'''Ichikishima Shrine''' (市杵島神社) or '''Ichikishima-hime Shrine''' (市杵島姫神社) is a [[|Shinto shrine]]

dedicated to [[]], one of the [[]]. Due to the syncretism of [[|Buddhism]] and [[Shinto]] ([[|Shinbutsu-shūgō]]), Ichikishima-hime is often associated with the Buddhist deity [[Benzaiten]], and many shrines dedicated to her are colloquially referred to as Benten (弁才天, 弁財天, or 弁天). She is also frequently enshrined as a subsidiary deity within the precincts of temples and shrines.

According to the myth associated with the descent of the heavenly grandson ([[|Tenson Kōrin]]), the three goddesses safeguarded Ninigi-no-Mikoto, leading to their veneration as protectors of children and their dedication in child-related shrines.
